probes.name: time-boundary-0
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
Dim a As Double,b As Double,f As Object
On Error GoTo Failed
a=Date:b=Date+1
Range("A1").Value2=a-1/86400
Range("A2").Value2=a
Range("A3").Value2=a+0.5
Range("A4").Value2=b-1/86400
Range("A5").Value2=b
Set f=Range("A1:A5").FormatConditions.Add(Type:=11,DateOperator:=0)
f.Font.Bold=True
Application.CalculateFull
Probe=Bits(Range("A1:A5"))
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Bits(r As Range) As String
Dim c As Range
For Each c In r.Cells
If c.DisplayFormat.Font.Bold Then
Bits=Bits & "1"
Else
Bits=Bits & "0"
End If
Next
End Function
